entities.summary: Julieta Pareja is an American tennis player. She has a career-high ITF junior combined ranking of No. 7, achieved on June 9, 2025. She also has career-high WTA rankings of No. 317 in singles, achieved on May 19, 2025, and No. 1,489 in doubles, achieved on October 7, 2024.
